name: Sh2-308 (Hubble)
blurb: Sh2-308, a bubble of gas blown by the Wolf-Rayet star EZ Canis Majoris, seen by Hubble.
label: sh2308-hubble
story: Thin strands trace the edge of a vast bubble inflated by the fierce winds of a massive star. Along this southwest rim, hot gas from the bubble's interior meets its cooler shell.

claims.text: Sh2-308 is a bubble-like shell of gas around the star EZ Canis Majoris
EZ Canis Majoris is a Wolf-Rayet star whose winds sweep up and blow out surrounding gas
The image shows thin strands of the shell, not the whole bubble
Program 12875 targets the southwest limb of the bubble S308, studying the front where the hot interior meets the cool nebular shell
